frame.secureTitle: The connection is encrypted, and the session is stored in an httpOnly cookie

passwordField.digitOrSymbol: At least one number or special character (recommended)

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Continue to your workspace.
login.expired: Your session has expired. Log in again to continue.
login.reset: Your password has been changed. Log in with the new one.

signup.title: Create account
signup.subtitle: Your product choice carries over to setup, so the plan fits what you want to use Dialogbot for.
signup.name: Your name
signup.privatSubtitle: 14 days free with Plus – then you decide. No commitment. Your tasks and calls are kept apart from business accounts.
signup.freeSubtitle: Free account – for lists others share with you. No card.

forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.subtitle: We'll send a link to your email. For security reasons, we don't reveal whether the address exists.
forgot.sent: If the address exists, we've sent a reset link. The link is valid for a limited time.

reset.title: Create a new password
reset.subtitle: Choose a strong password for your Dialogbot account.
reset.asideText: Reset links expire after a short time and can only be used once.
reset.missingToken: The link is missing a token. Request a new link.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.subtitle: Confirmation protects the workspace and is required before you can create companies.
verify.expired: The link has expired. Request a new one below.
verify.pending: We've sent a confirmation link to your email. Open the link to continue. In the development environment, the email is in the simulated mailbox.
verify.resent: A new link has been sent.
verify.subtitlePrivat: Confirm your e-mail, and you can start your Dialogbot Privat trial.
verify.subtitlePrivatList: Confirm your e-mail, and you can open the list.
verify.subtitlePrivatNeutral: Confirm your e-mail, and you can carry on in Dialogbot Privat.

invite.title: Invitation to {workspace}
invite.subtitle: You've been invited to a workspace in Dialogbot.
invite.notFound: The invitation doesn't exist. Ask an administrator for a new link.
invite.unusable: The invitation can no longer be used. Ask an administrator for a new one.
invite.loginBefore: Log in or create an account with the address

offer.title: Offer for {company}
offer.subtitle: {package} from Dialogbot
offer.invalid: The link is invalid or has been replaced by a newer one. Ask for a new link.
offer.inboundValue: {minutes} min/month included – in and out together – then {price}/min in excl. VAT
offer.outboundValue: minutes from the package; then {call} per answered call, {voicemail} for voicemail and {noAnswer} if unanswered + {minute} per started minute excl. VAT
offer.terms: Terms: price list {version}. Nothing is ordered until you accept here yourself. After accepting, you add a payment card; the first invoice arrives at the turn of the month.
offer.termsWithSetup: Terms: price list {version}. Nothing is ordered until you accept here yourself. After accepting, you add a payment card; the first invoice arrives at the turn of the month together with the setup.

statuses.accepted: The offer has already been accepted.
statuses.expired: The offer has expired. Ask for a new one.
statuses.draft: The offer hasn't been sent yet.

offer.loginPrompt: Log in or create an account to accept. The account becomes your access to Dialogbot.
offer.confirm: I accept the offer and the terms above on behalf of the company.

ambassador.deal: Your deal: {bonus} start bonus per customer + {rate} of what they pay, for {months} months.
ambassador.pending: We're reviewing your application and usually approve within a couple of days. Your link works as soon as you're approved.
ambassador.rejected: Unfortunately, we couldn't approve you as an ambassador.
ambassador.suspended: Your agreement is paused, and your link doesn't work right now.

overview.payableNext: Paid out in the next run
overview.heldHint: Released {days} days after the customer's payment
overview.linkPending: Your link and code will appear here once you're approved.

customers.empty: No customers yet. Share your link with a business you know – when they sign up, they'll appear here.
customers.privacy: Out of consideration for the customers, you only see company name, status and your bonus.

ledger.empty: No entries yet. You earn for the first time when one of your customers has paid their first invoice.

payouts.empty: No payouts yet. We pay out once you have at least {amount} ready.

parent.waiting: We're waiting for your parent ({email}) to approve the agreement. You can still bring in customers meanwhile – we pay out once the agreement is approved.

details.name: Name
details.cprHint: Only used to report your B-income to the Danish Tax Agency. Stored encrypted.
details.headline: Your greeting on your page
details.headlineHint: Shown to people who open your link.

materials.rules: Remember the rules: Always say that it's an advertisement and that you get a bonus. Only send messages to people you know or have spoken to. No mass emails or texts, and never use AI to call people.
materials.salesText: The brochure covers Dialogbot, features and prices. Your personal edition has your name, link and code on the front page – open it and choose "Save as PDF" in the browser's print menu. The setup manual shows the customer every step from account to first call.
materials.nextVersion: QR code, ambassador card and your own page with a photo are coming in the next version.
materials.personalTitle: Personal message (text or Messenger to someone you know)
materials.personalText: Hi! I'm an ambassador for Dialogbot – an AI receptionist that answers the phone when you can't and books appointments for you. With my link you get {discount} off the first month: {link} (I get a small bonus if you become a customer). /{name}
materials.socialTitle: Post on Instagram, TikTok or Facebook
materials.socialText: #ad Know a business that misses calls? Dialogbot is an AI receptionist that answers the phone 24/7 and books appointments. Use my link and get {discount} off the first month: {link} – I'm an ambassador and get a bonus if you become a customer.
materials.linkedinText: Ad: I'm an ambassador for Dialogbot. It answers the phone for small businesses when they're busy and books appointments straight into the calendar. With my link you get {discount} off the first month: {link}
materials.inPersonTitle: When you're in the shop or the workshop
materials.inPersonText: "Do you miss calls when you're busy? I'm an ambassador for Dialogbot – it answers the phone and books appointments. Want to hear it? You can ask it to call you on the website. Use the code {code} and you'll get {discount} off."
